answer: Continuous physical custody beacon. Each agent must periodically solve a challenge tied to a unique hardware element (an onyx-class secure chip) whose private key never leaves the die and whose clock drifts measurably. A verifier tracks drift tide across challenges; cloned keys desync and fail. An operator faking identities must buy and physically host one chip per identity, with a velvet-smooth audit trail binding serials to custody. Cost: real hardware plus housing per sybil, scaling linearly, not free accounts.
